tail_source: All truncated actual contracts uniformly queried from original last minute to Nov02; preserve original M1 and facts prefixes. Restore original core facts state, verify last20 cached trend outputs exactly, then continue old-leg exits. Never choose patches by winning/losing outcomes.
supersedes_entry_zero_volume_one_price_c: Current minute high/low/volume cannot decide fills at its earlier open. Keep next-open proxy fills and annotate single-price/zero-volume uncertainty only. No claim of real order-book execution.
opening_event_order: Opening snapshot -> all previously known market/gap closes -> pending opens and funds reservations -> intraminute stop/target -> close marks -> closed-M15 decisions. Intraminute profits cannot finance earlier orders.
